question: How many people in India might click on a cricket-related ad during IPL?
idealClarificationQuestions: Single match window or full IPL season? Full season (~70 matches over 60 days).
Across all IPL ad inventory: TV + JioCinema + JioHotstar + YouTube + display? Yes.
Click = engaged action (CTV remote click, app tap, web click)? Yes.
All advertisers combined or single advertiser? Single representative cricket-related advertiser (e.g., a Dream11/Vimal-style brand).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: IPL viewership concurrent peak: ~9-10 crore; cumulative reach: ~50 crore unique viewers across season.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Plus connected TV (CTV) interactive impressions: ~20 crore.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Average CTR for cricket-context ads (highly engaged audience): ~1.2-1.5% (vs general 0.5-0.8%).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Single dominant advertiser (e.g., Tata, Dream11) gets ~30% of these = ~1 crore clicks.

benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~9-10 crore; cumulative reach: ~50 crore unique viewers across season.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Total digital + CTV ad impressions IPL season
Average CTR for cricket-context ads (highly engaged audience)

benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~250 cr × 1.3% = ~3.25 crore clicks across season for an active advertiser.

calculationFlow: IPL viewership concurrent peak: ~9-10 crore; cumulative reach: ~50 crore unique viewers across season.
Total ad impressions (digital only) on JioCinema/JioHotstar across 70 matches: ~150-200 crore impressions.
Plus connected TV (CTV) interactive impressions: ~20 crore.
Plus YouTube cricket adjacency: ~50 crore impressions.
Total digital + CTV ad impressions IPL season: ~220-270 crore.
Total clicks: ~250 cr × 1.3% = ~3.25 crore clicks across season for an active advertiser.
Single dominant advertiser (e.g., Tata, Dream11) gets ~30% of these = ~1 crore clicks.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: Single dominant advertiser (e.g., Tata, Dream11) gets ~30% of these = ~1 crore clicks.
